# Projects — Dhruvil Mistry Portfolio
> Directory and technical details of AI and full-stack software projects built by Dhruvil Mistry.

## 1. Tax Mitra (AI Income-Tax Notice & Workflow Assistant)
- **Overview:** AI-powered workflow helping Indian taxpayers understand income-tax notices, determine position, draft evidence-backed responses, and navigate filing with grounded sources, deterministic rules, and human approval.
- **Tech Stack:** Next.js, FastAPI, Python, RAG, Deterministic Rules, LLMs.
- **Live URL:** https://taxmitra.bydhruvil.in
- **GitHub:** https://github.com/dhruvil-codes/taxmitra

## 2. Nudge (Autonomous AI Gmail Follow-Up Agent)
- **Overview:** Zero-setup CLI tool and MCP agent that identifies unanswered email threads and drafts contextual follow-ups using Groq Llama 3.3 70B.
- **Tech Stack:** Python, CLI, Groq LLM, Llama 3.3 70B, MCP, SQLite, Google OAuth.
- **Live URL:** https://bydhruvil.in/projects

## 3. Minutz (AI Meeting Intelligence Platform)
- **Overview:** Browser-native meeting recorder with async AI processing for summary, action item extraction, and speaker tracking.
- **Tech Stack:** FastAPI, Next.js, OpenAI Whisper, GPT-4o, Supabase, TailwindCSS.
- **Recognition:** Selected among top projects at OpenAI × Outskill Hackathon.
- **Live URL:** https://bydhruvil.in/projects

## 4. Saral AI (Voice AI Receptionist)
- **Overview:** Real-time, ultra-low latency voice bot handling customer inbound calls for small businesses and clinics.
- **Tech Stack:** FastAPI, Python, Groq (Llama 3), Sarvam AI (Indic TTS/STT), WebSockets.
- **Live URL:** https://bydhruvil.in/projects

## 5. Skin Cure (Multimodal Healthcare Classifier)
- **Overview:** Computer vision model trained on 28k dermatology clinical images to detect skin conditions and connect patients to nearby specialists.
- **Tech Stack:** PyTorch, SwinV2 Transformer, FastAPI, React, Leaflet.js.
- **Live URL:** https://bydhruvil.in/projects

## 6. Clarity (AI Reading Assistant Extension)
- **Overview:** Multi-provider Manifest V3 Chrome extension providing instant page summarization and deep context synthesis.
- **Tech Stack:** JavaScript, Chrome Extension MV3, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini API.
- **Live URL:** https://bydhruvil.in/projects
